name: What Is Deep Work?
equipment: A notebook and a distraction-free block of time
instructions: Deep work is focused, undistracted effort on one cognitively demanding task -- as opposed to "shallow work" like email or quick admin tasks.
Block a specific window today (even just 25-45 minutes) for one task only, with notifications off.
Notice how often the urge to check your phone or switch tasks shows up -- that impulse is exactly what deep work practice trains you against.
Watch today's video for the full concept before starting your first session.
